_doc: The book registry. One entry per sourcebook this catalog cites, keyed by
the .cache/books/<slug> directory name.
`source_book` is free text in every table that holds it, and three separate
mechanisms parse it: resolveBookSlug (a row -> its cached pages),
drift-check's citation check, and the extraction prompt that fills the field
in the first place. Before this file each one guessed differently, and the
312 gear rows spelling the Palladium Fantasy main book `Palladium RPG Main
Book` resolved to nothing at all - every word of that title is generic, so
the word-overlap route is disabled by design and the initialism route needs
a `pf` the title never spells. An alias list is the only route they have.
title          the canonical spelling. The extraction prompt offers these
as the allowed values, so a NEW row should use one.
aliases        every OTHER spelling production actually contains, seeded
from the live vocabulary on 2026-08-27. A row cites its
book with a ` p.N-M` suffix; that is stripped before the
match, and matching ignores case and punctuation.
source_pdf     basename of the PDF the cache was built from, as the
manifests record it - or would be built from, for a book
with no cache yet. null when no copy is on hand.
source_pdf_dir the directory that PDF was read from. With source_pdf
it is the whole recovery record for a cache: .cache/
books/ is gitignored by design - it is the full text of
books Palladium still sells - so a cache is rebuildable
with one ocr-book.py run per book, and a PDF nobody
kept is not rebuildable at all. null when source_pdf
is. These PDFs are the only irreplaceable artifact in
this pipeline; this field says where they were.
printed_pages  the book's own last printed FOLIO, not the PDF page count.
With page_offset this GATES the citation check: a cache
holding fewer pages than the book has is not consulted,
whatever the PDF it was built from happened to hold. These
two outrank the manifest's own copies, because a manifest
derived from a truncated cache reports the truncation.
The two differ by the offset plus whatever unnumbered ads
the scan carries. null when it has never been measured.
page_offset    cache file page = printed folio + page_offset. Measured
with detectPageOffset over the cache. null when unknown.
page_offset_exceptions
ordered [{ printed_through, offset }] for a book that does
NOT paginate constantly. First match wins, everything past
the last falls through to page_offset. Only `pf` has one,
and a majority vote over the whole book cannot see it: the
minority region is 11 pages against 287. class-check
--field-sources reports every region it detects, so the
next book with a split announces itself.
note           why a value is what it is, when it is not simply measured.
Adding a book means adding an entry: class-check warns about a source_book
that matches no title and no alias, and does not fail on it. Nothing here is
required for a cache to exist, and a slug with no cache resolves to null.
Two gear provenance markers are NOT books. They say where a price came
from, not which book, and they are listed under `not_books` rather than
left out: left out, `Estimate - no published price found` resolved to `pf`
for 104 rows, because the initialism route reads e-n-p-p-f and finds `pf`
inside it. Anything in `not_books` resolves to nothing, by both routes.

pf.title: Palladium Fantasy RPG Main Book
pf.note: The most-cited book in the database, and the ONE book whose offset is not constant. An extra page sits at cache p018/p019 - p019 holds p018's text plus a Throwing Objects table - so printed 1-16 are at +1 and printed 18-336 at +2, 11 votes against 287. Printed 17 is left to the +2 rule on purpose: that lands on p019, the fuller of the two. This is the case book-survey 0d is thirty lines about, and its worked example - the Attribute Bonus Chart at printed 16 - is inside the exception.

bom.title: Rifts Book of Magic
bom.note: Re-cached 2026-08-28 from its TEXT LAYER, all 360 pages (INGESTION-AUDIT F24). The layer is not sparse - --probe medians 5,411 chars/page, comparable to pf - and the earlier six-page OCR cache (p090-p095) was the mistake this note used to describe as a decision. printed_pages stays 352 and NOT the 347 ocr-book.py measured: printed 348-352 is the Index of Rifts Magic, the authority table giving every spell a name, cost and page, and its folios do not surface the same way. This is the case the _doc's 'the registry outranks the manifest' rule was written for.

cb1.title: Rifts Conversion Book One
cb1.note: The 200-page PDF ends in a Palladium catalogue and order form the book does not number; the last folio is 172.

dag.title: Palladium Fantasy Dragons and Gods
dag.note: Same appended catalogue as cb1: 240 PDF pages, 232 numbered.

fom.title: Rifts World Book 16: Federation of Magic
fom.source_pdf: Rifts- World Book 16 Federation of Magic.pdf
fom.note: Nothing in production cites this book yet. Its cache stopped at file p073 - printed 72, mid-word and mid-class - until the resume fix in F2 read the remaining 88 pages off the source PDF; it now holds all 161.

potm.title: Rifts Conversion Book Two: Pantheons of the Megaverse
potm.note: Content ends at printed 203 and the index runs to 208. The cache held 202 of the PDF's 210 pages until the resume fix in F2 topped it up; it now holds all 210.

ww.title: Rifts Dimension Book 1: Wormwood
ww.note: The second book here with a ZERO offset, and the only one whose folios line up with the PDF end to end: printed N is cache pNNN and read-columns.py N. Verified on printed 3, 4, 5, 6, 83 and 157 by reading the folio off the render, and measured independently by ocr-book.py. A scan with no text layer, but a clean one - no page needed a re-read and no table pages needed a higher dpi.

rifts-core.title: Rifts RPG (original core book)
rifts-core.note: NOT A MISSING BOOK AND NOT ONE TO CACHE. This is the ORIGINAL Rifts core book; Rifts Ultimate Edition is its errata'd revision - the same book, a later edition. Cited by NOTHING since 2026-08-28: the last row citing it, the dragon-hatchling class, was re-cited to RUE p.156-159 alongside its six variants (REBUILD-AUDIT.md F17). Kept in the registry so the spelling stays known vocabulary if it reappears. The earlier note here said two classes cited it and that it was the next book to cache; one did, and it is not.

rifts-skill-list.title: Rifts Skill List
rifts-skill-list.note: Not a Palladium book - a compiled skill list PDF, cited by 48 skills. Registered so those rows read as known vocabulary rather than as an unknown book.

triax.title: Rifts World Book 5: Triax and the NGR
triax.source_pdf: Rifts- World Book 5 Triax and the NGR.pdf
triax.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from a SCAN - no text layer, --probe medians 0 chars/page across all twenty samples. The THIRD zero-offset book here after potm and ww: printed N is cache pNNN, and read-columns.py N+1. Verified by folio rather than assumed - 177 pages agree at +0 against 1 at +1 - which matters because a zero offset leaves no discrepancy to explain when a page reads wrong. The five disagreements are OCR misreading the folio itself (p134 reads 693), not an offset region. Was a stub carrying one gear row and no copy on hand until the PDF arrived in the seven-book batch; the alias is live vocabulary that row resolves through and is kept.

underseas.title: Rifts World Book 7: Underseas
underseas.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from a SCAN - --probe medians 0 chars/page. Nothing in production cites this book yet. printed_pages and page_offset pending the end of the OCR run.

new-west.title: Rifts World Book 14: New West
new-west.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from its TEXT LAYER, median 3,784 chars/page. printed_pages is 224 and NOT the 222 ocr-book.py measured: printed 223-224 are the experience tables, which print no folio, and the registry outranks the manifest for exactly this reason (see bom). Offset verified by folio, 198 pages agreeing against 3 - and those 3 are contents pages listing many numbers, not a second offset region. Was a stub carrying one skill row (W.P. Rope) and no copy on hand; the alias is kept as live vocabulary.

spirit-west.title: Rifts World Book 15: Spirit West
spirit-west.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from its TEXT LAYER, median 5,468 chars/page. Offset verified by folio: 190 pages agree, the 2 that do not are contents pages. Nothing in production cites this book yet.

mystic-russia.title: Rifts World Book 18: Mystic Russia
mystic-russia.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from its TEXT LAYER, median 5,102 chars/page. The cleanest offset measurement in the batch - 157 pages agree at +1 and NONE disagree. The last three cache pages are Palladium house ads for The Rifter, which the book does not number. Nothing in production cites this book yet.

free-quebec.title: Rifts World Book 22: Free Quebec
free-quebec.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from its TEXT LAYER, median 4,801 chars/page. Offset verified by folio, 165 pages agreeing against 4; two of those are contents pages and two (p86, p181) are stray numbers in prose on pages whose folio did not survive as a bare line. Nothing in production cites this book yet.

phase-world.title: Rifts Dimension Book 2: Phase World
phase-world.note: Cached 2026-08-28 from a SCAN - --probe medians 0 chars/page. Nothing in production cites this book yet. printed_pages and page_offset pending the end of the OCR run.
